name: Dark Chocolate Espresso Barracuda Bar | 200mg
description:
COFFEE LOVERS REJOICE!

The NEW Dark Chocolate Espresso Barracuda Bar from Detroit Edibles is a decadent addition to our line up of THC infused chocolate. Smooth dark chocolate produced from 65% Belgian Chocolate, combined with rich espresso flavors, and the purest distillate from our very own Michigan-made Cannalicious Labs, our espresso dark bar is sure to be your new preferred mocha coffee treat.
